scope: Deduplicate Linux wheel and CLI builds across the three-venue public quickstart matrix

change.before: Each OKX, Binance, and Bitget matrix job built the same Linux release wheel and qx-cli binary.
change.after: One build job uploads a tar archive; all three venue jobs download and reuse it, then independently install the wheel and execute public-data acceptance.

limitations: The previous hosted run 43452540386 had all three venue jobs in the repeated release build step; workflow step status alone does not reveal whether each build was still compiling or resource-starved.
Artifact upload/download, executable mode restoration, wheel import, and public-data execution need a new hosted CI run.
This workflow optimization does not establish six-month data availability or connector maturity.
